units: MW power, MWh energy, USD assumed-cost proxy (not CEN costs); hours are step indices from 0
binding_constraints: line_limit L2: hours 11-14 (flow n_norte_chico -> n_centro at 600 MW limit)
ramp_limit gas_ng: hours 9, 16-17 (output changing at the 150 MW/h ramp limit)
ramp_limit coal_cs: hours 10-11, 15 (output changing at the 60 MW/h ramp limit)
ramp_limit gas_centro: hours 18 (output changing at the 250 MW/h ramp limit)
battery_full b_centro: hours 14-18 (state of charge at 60 MWh capacity (end of hour))
battery_empty b_centro: hours 3-9, 21 (state of charge at 0 MWh minimum (end of hour))
renewable_curtailed solar_ng: hours 11-14 (available renewable output not used)
dispatchable_at_capacity hydro_sur: hours 0-23 (output at 200 MW capacity)

prices_usd_per_mwh.note: LP marginal values (cost of 1 MWh more demand at that node and hour); informational, not independently validated

notes: Investment cost of the modifications is not modelled.
Costs are an assumed-cost proxy on a synthetic, illustrative network, not CEN costs.
Hourly transport model on a radial network; sub-hourly dynamics and reserves are not modelled.
